about: Work-mode corpus for detectWorkMode(location, title), built 2026-11-15 for job-board .102 (BR-08 + S14X-248). Labels never come from the rule under test. kind 'hand': read from the posting's own page or the vendor's detail field at `read` (Workday CXS remoteType, Oracle WorkplaceType, Ashby workplaceType, Workable workplace, BambooHR locationType, or the page text quoted in basis); 'unstated' means the page states no work mode, so the right reading is none. kind 'vendor': the feed's own field (Lever/Ashby workplaceType, SmartRecruiters location.remote/hybrid, Workable telecommuting, where false is 'notremote'). main = the reading of fix/cost-wave b2903605.
scoring: unstated: none is right, any mode is wrong. notremote: remote is wrong, anything else is none. Otherwise: equal is right, none is none, a different mode is wrong.

vendorCorpus.source: board-stream-2026-11-01 corpora (fields/raw, recheck/raw, review/raw-lever) + post-deploy-c4a29736 theplace1 SmartRecruiters feeds
